text:
Cannulas that are in use should be flushed with 0.9% sodium chloride before and after each medication or infusion. A cannula that is left in but unused should be flushed at least every 8–12 hours, and 12-hourly is the most common local policy. I can't confirm the note's claim that guidance requires flushing every 4 hours (six times a day), because standard guidance doesn't say that, so check your local hospital policy.

CONFIDENCE: 80
